rootLicense.sourceZipLicenseNote: The LICENSE file inside each source.zip is the same MIT body as the official frozen upstream LICENSE, plus one extra trailing newline (1067 vs 1066 bytes). The batch ./LICENSE file matches the official 1066-byte text (SHA-256 25d698c61ceea4d42107ef85ef37d4449f1169ca24c7ee288db434688071e1e3).

productionRuntime.classification: Preview runtimes embed locally authored geometric SVG data URIs (identical landscape template, different hsl hues) in place of upstream remote photos and mac desktop/icon paths. These SVGs are self-made decorations, not the original photographs or mac assets, and are not a fidelity restore. Outgoing https links in the demos (docs, social, pro.ui-layouts.com, apple.com) are text references, not packaged media.

adaptedDemosInSourceZip.remotePhotosAndMacRaster: replaced with the same family of self-made SVG data URIs
adaptedDemosInSourceZip.timelineNotoFireGif: replaced with a plain text decorative star (✦), not the original artwork

preservedUpstreamOriginalsInSourceZip.stillContain: Unsplash photo URLs, fonts.gstatic.com Noto emoji GIF URL, /macos.jpg and /macicon.png paths
preservedUpstreamOriginalsInSourceZip.packagedRasterFiles: none of those remote/path assets are stored as files in the zip or batch
preservedUpstreamOriginalsInSourceZip.classification: upstream source text references retained; media rights for those photographs/GIF/raster files are not asserted here and they are not used by the production preview
preservedUpstreamOriginalsInSourceZip.footerLogo: footers/animated-logo-footer.tsx keeps original inline SVG path letterforms from the UI Layouts source (upstream, MIT), not a replacement graphic

unusedSourceHelper.src/lib/utils.ts: contains remote og.jpg URLs on ui-layouts.com; those strings are not present in the production runtimes (not a preview asset). Rights not assessed.

media.sharedCssSwapyUtilities: Production CSS in all three batches contains Tailwind-generated [data-swapy-dragging] utilities from the shared stylesheet. That is not the swapy JavaScript library. The GPL-3.0 swapy package is in the next-01 JavaScript runtime only.

compileRecipe.feasibility: The frozen zip already has a portable exact npm lock and Vite 8.3.1 build entry, so the compile recipe can be restored with npm ci && npm run build from that zip. This pass did not repeat a clean install or rebuild, and did not reconstruct the full devDependency license set (vite, typescript, tailwind toolchain natives, rolldown bindings, etc.).
compileRecipe.currentRuntimeMayDiffer: Each zip also has closure-build.log sizes for an earlier successful isolated build. Later preview-only patches exist in the atlas batch (uilayout-next-02 LOAD-FIX-NOTES / genie-effect patch; uilayout-next-03 raws-color-picker patch). A clean rebuild from the zip therefore is not claimed to be byte-identical to the current production runtime.js.

remainingUnknown: Full license text for react-remove-scroll-bar@2.3.8 (next-02 and next-03 closures only): missing from the published tarball and no matching git tag was found.
DevDependency license texts for a clean rebuild are not included.

Whether every lock-closure package is actually emitted into the minified runtime (tree-shaking) was not byte-proven for each transitive; the notices cover the evidenced import graph plus the lock closure, not a reconstructed module list from the minified bundle.
Browser visual and interaction acceptance remains unverified.

The shared next-01 IIFE includes swapy@1.0.5 under GPL-3.0, so redistributing this runtime is not MIT-only. A commercial Swapy license is mentioned in that package README and was not obtained or used here.

licenseMaterialsInDownloadableSourceZip.note: Users who obtain this branch’s collections/.../source.zip receive the root MIT LICENSE plus THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt, LICENSE-PACK.md and SOURCE-LICENSE.json. Catalog archive URLs that still point at main do not receive these additions until that URL is updated by a publish/merge, which this line does not do.
